parsed.doc_summary: LAHD RSO Overview page: LA Rent Stabilization Ordinance coverage (pre-Oct 1, 1978 buildings), annual rent increase limits, just-cause eviction grounds, notice filing and relocation assistance, and interest on security deposits mentioned only as a topic.

rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance - allowable rent increases
rules.requirement: For RSO units, rent may be raised only once every 12 months by the allowable percentage set by LAHD. Since Feb 2, 2026, no extra percentage for utilities and no 10% for an added dependent; 10% for an added non-dependent tenant is still allowed.
rules.citation: L.A. Mun. Code ch. XV, art. 1 (Rent Stabilization Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage
rules.key_value: Once per 12 months; allowable annual percentage set by LAHD
rules.effective_date_note: Feb 2, 2026 per LAHD for the revised formula (no utility add-on, no dependent 10%); original ordinance effective earlier.

unverifiable_exemptions: condominiums and townhomes: rent not regulated for tenancies commenced after Dec 31, 1995

rules.conflict_note: A landlord association reportedly published 2026-01-24 as the effective date of the new formula; LAHD says 2026-02-02.
rules.interaction: Local RSO governs instead of the state Tenant Protection Act cap for covered units.
rules.exemptions: Condos/townhomes with tenancies commenced after 12/31/1995 not rent-regulated; luxury exemption; temporary exemptions.

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO - just cause eviction, notice filing and relocation assistance
rules.requirement: RSO tenants can be evicted only for listed at-fault or no-fault reasons. All termination notices must be filed with LAHD within three business days of service, and no-fault evictions require relocation assistance and a Landlord Declaration of Intent to Evict.
rules.quoted_span: All notices to terminate a tenancy for all rental units subject to City’s Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO ) must be filed with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) within three (3) business days of service on the tenant
rules.key_value: Listed causes only; no-fault requires relocation assistance; LAHD filing within 3 business days
rules.conflict_note: Page also references the separate Just Cause Ordinance for non-RSO properties; not detailed here.
